title: 2021 Halloween Spooktacular!
summary: Josh and Chuck's annual Halloween "Spooktacular" episode, presented ad-free, with two public domain horror stories read aloud. The first is M. R. James's "Lost Hearts," about orphan Stephen Elliott who goes to live with his cousin Mr. Abney at Aswarby Hall, hears of Mrs. Bunch's stories about missing children Phoebe Stanley and Giovanni Paoli, and discovers Abney's papers describing a ritual to gain power by absorbing the hearts of children; Abney is killed by the children's ghosts. The second is Arthur Machen's "The Great God Pan" (first chapter), in which Dr. Raymond performs a brain operation on the young woman Mary, with his friend Clark as witness, to let her see the god Pan; the experiment leaves Mary incapacitated. The hosts add content notes on dated racial and ethnic language in the 19th-century texts and close with Halloween safety wishes.

segments.title: Opening banter and content warnings
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck introduce the ad-free Halloween Spooktacular, pick the two public domain stories, and warn that the 19th-century texts contain dated racial and ethnic terms and xenophobic opinions expressed by a character.

segments.title: Lost Hearts, part one: arrival at Aswarby Hall
segments.summary: Reading of M. R. James's 'Lost Hearts' begins. Orphan Stephen Elliott arrives at Aswarby Hall to live with his reclusive cousin Mr. Abney, and housekeeper Mrs. Bunch recounts the earlier disappearances of a girl and a Italian boy named Giovanni who had been taken in by the household.

segments.title: Lost Hearts, part two: the bathtub figure and scratches
segments.summary: Stephen sees a decaying figure in the old bathroom bath and then finds scratches on his nightgown and bedroom door. Mrs. Bunch compares the marks to claws, and Parkes the butler reports strange sounds in the wine cellar.

segments.title: Lost Hearts, part three: the children and Abney's papers
segments.summary: Abney summons Stephen to his study. Stephen sees two child ghosts on the terrace, then finds Abney dead with his heart exposed. Abney's papers describe a ritual of absorbing the hearts of three children under twenty-one, naming Phoebe Stanley, Giovanni Paoli, and Stephen himself, to gain power and immortality.

segments.title: Ad-free spooky break
segments.summary: Hosts say the episode is ad-free and mention a sponsor line that is read as a joke for the Halloween version.

segments.title: Introduction to The Great God Pan
segments.summary: Chuck and Josh introduce Arthur Machen's 'The Great God Pan', noting that the first chapter was originally published as a standalone short story before being expanded into a novella.

segments.title: The Great God Pan: Dr. Raymond's plan
segments.summary: Dr. Raymond tells his friend Clark that he has discovered a brain procedure, a small lesion, that will let a person see a spirit world and the god Pan. He describes his years of work and claims the operation is safe.

segments.title: The Great God Pan: the operation on Mary
segments.summary: Raymond prepares his laboratory and sedates Clark with an odor that induces a vivid memory and dream. Mary, a young woman Raymond rescued from the gutter, is brought in, sedated, and operated on. Afterward she is left unresponsive, and Raymond says she has seen the Great God Pan.

segments.title: Outro and Halloween wishes
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck praise the readings, remark on the Halloween season, urge listeners to follow CDC guidelines for trick-or-treating, and sign off with the show's credits.
